title: The Forge of Giants
briefing: In the Frozen Reach an enemy warlord has found the old forges of the giants, and he is using them. His smiths are building a Titan - and when it walks, nothing in the north will stand against it.
Three forges feed it. Every one you destroy sets the Titan back, and leaves it weaker. Break the forges, storm the fortress - or be ready when the Titan comes for you.
